lines.text: Many learners say: I don't like fish. Me too.
Better: I don't like fish. Me neither.
After a no, say me neither.
Me neither! I can't swim. Me neither.

data.wrong: I don't like fish. Me too.
data.right: I don't like fish. Me neither.
data.why: After a no, say me neither.

native.hook: ตอบปฏิเสธ ใช้ Me neither!

native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “I don't like fish. Me too.” ไหม? 😅 ไทยตอบว่า “ฉันก็เหมือนกัน” ได้ทั้งสองกรณี จึงมักพูด Me too แต่หลังประโยคปฏิเสธ ต้องพูด Me neither: “I don't like fish. Me neither.” ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite

en.tip: Thai answers with one phrase for both cases, so people say Me too, but after a no English says Me neither.
en.caption: Do you say “I don't like fish. Me too.” 😅 Thai answers with one phrase for both cases, so people say Me too, but after a no English says Me neither. Say “I don't like fish. Me neither.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
